_about: NIST security categories per parameter set, transcribed from the standards themselves (not from product code) for test_algid.test_categories_match_fips_transcription. Second-agent check (O-9): PR #94 review 5874701640, all 20 values agree with the primary documents; two citations corrected after it (FIPS 203 section, FN-DSA source).

_sources.FIPS 203: FIPS 203 (August 13, 2024), Section 8 prose ('ML-KEM-512 is claimed to be in security category 1, ML-KEM-768 ... category 3, and ML-KEM-1024 ... category 5') and the Section 3.2 overview; Table 2 lists parameters and RBG strength, not categories
_sources.FIPS 204: FIPS 204 (August 13, 2024), Section 4, Table 1 'ML-DSA parameter sets': ML-DSA-44 category 2, ML-DSA-65 category 3, ML-DSA-87 category 5
_sources.FIPS 205: FIPS 205 (August 13, 2024), Section 11, Table 2 'SLH-DSA parameter sets': the -128s/-128f sets category 1, -192s/-192f category 3, -256s/-256f category 5, for both SHA2 and SHAKE
_sources.FN-DSA: Falcon specification v1.2 (NIST PQC round 3), Section 2.6, eq. 2.8/2.9: n=512 targets NIST Level I, n=1024 Level V (FN-DSA-512 category 1, FN-DSA-1024 category 5). FIPS 206 is forthcoming: no draft was published when this was transcribed
